distractors.reason: We don't say 'depend of'. 'Depend' is always followed by 'on' in this meaning.
We don't say 'depend at'. 'At' is used with verbs like 'look at' or 'stare at', not with 'depend'.
We don't say 'depend for' in this sense. 'For' appears with 'wait for' or 'ask for', not with 'depend'.

example_sentence: Our conclusions depend ___ the quality of the data.
l1_interference: Türkçede 'bağlı' bağlılık ekiyle (-e) ifade edildiği için öğrenciler 'depend the data' ya da 'depend of the data' gibi yapılar kurabilir. İngilizcede doğru kalıp 'depend on' şeklindedir.
explanation: In English, 'depend on' means that one thing is determined by or relies on another. It is common in academic writing when signposting conditions or results, for example 'the outcome depends on the evidence'.

related_collocations.example: Many scientists believe in the theory, but not all of them.
Please listen to the speaker before you ask questions.
Look at the chart to see the main trend.

memory_tip: DEPEND + ON = one thing relies on a condition | LISTEN + TO, LOOK + AT, WAIT + FOR = each verb has its own fixed preposition
